lead_raw_text:
The structure of CsNaCl₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms (Cs₂Na₂Cl₆) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Cs and Na centers, each surrounded by six Cl neighbors, while Cl centers show three geometric neighbors (two Cs, one Na). The analysis further reports corner-sharing between Cs and Na octahedra, and edge-sharing among like octahedra of both Cs and Na. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites.
